title: Dedicated lane set up along Roxas Boulevard for ASEAN Summit 2026 delegates
summary: A dedicated lane has been set up along Roxas Boulevard in Pasay City for vehicles transporting delegates and VIPs attending the ASEAN Summit.

blocks.text: A dedicated lane has been set up along Roxas Boulevard in Pasay City for vehicles transporting delegates and VIPs attending the ASEAN Summit.
Motorists are advised to expect heavier traffic in the area.

According to a report of GMA News' Bam Alegere on Unang Balita Wednesday, the dedicated lane is located near the center island of Roxas Boulevard and will be used for the transport of VIPs from different countries.

Security personnel have also been deployed to ensure security in areas where ASEAN Summit-related activities will be held, including the welcome arc, Cultural Center of the Philippines (CCP), World Trade Center, and Philippine International Convention Center (PICC).
With one lane allocated for summit-related vehicles, motorists can expect traffic buildup along affected portions of Roxas Boulevard.
A slight congestion was already observed along the concerned road on Wednesday morning, particularly after the Buendia Flyover. —Joviland Rita/ VAL, GMA News
